pieces.Text: A mithral golem's body can take on a form like liquid silver as a swift action.  While in this form, the mithral golem's reach increases to 30 feet and its DR becomes 15/bludgeoning and adamantine.  A mithral golem in this form can also move through any crack or hole in a wall or door, no matter how small, without impeding its movement.  A mithral golem can maintain this form for up to 10 rounds per day, but these rounds do not need to be consecutive.  Reverting to its normal form is a free action.
